notes.title: Update 2020.04.13.
notes.content:
-A Magyar nyelv bele került a játékba :)
-The Mechs weapons models looks better then ever.
-Enemy AI increased.
-Camera work while you drive a car or your mech is Better.
-Few new detail added to the game.
-Players FOV now better.

notes.title: Update 2020.03.31.
notes.content:
-Russian subtitle and menu subtitle added to the game.
-Next is the Hungarian language.

notes.title: Update 2020.03.30.
notes.content:
-Now you can destroy wood fences with firearms at Green River.
-Easter egg limit reduced to 20.
-Small tutorial added to the Hangar.
-Firearms now more Effective.
-New normal map for the shotgun.
-Energy recharger working perfect now.
-New Mech Armor upgrade added.
-Better FOV.
-Game now brighter at the first time.
-Some cinematic moment added or changed.

notes.title: Huge Update 2020.03.24.
notes.content:
-The energy core is now closer to the hangar.
-New mission added.
-Mech Armor upgrader added.
-Better UI.
-Enemy mass balanced.
-Huge texture performance fixed.
-More destroyable buildings and stuff.
-New Selfmaked-Stream free musics added.
-Shadow vibration fixed on some hidden place.
-Modherships now have hard colliders.
